    Profile

    Ignacio is a member of The Infinite Serpent who hails from the Superbia Belt Region. He serves the organization to repay a debt of gratitude to his High Elf stepfather. He hides the void in his heart with a veil of false politeness, but what he wants most of all is someone or something to entrust his legacy to.

    Origin: Superbia Belt Region
    Gender: Male
    Height: 178cm
    Weight: 67kg
    Birthday: Dec 5
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Nightmare Cherry Blossom
    Likes: The World
    Hobbies: Chatting
    Illust: だーくろ（G-ROW）
    CV: 新垣樽助
